# Fire Mage — Raid (group)

[Mage](../README.md) > [Raid (group)](README.md) > Fire

**✅ Recommended** for raid (the best mage spec here, or within 3% of it).

**[Fire — Ignite / Hot Streak](../research/raid/builds/fire-raid.md)** (12/34/5) — [open the talent tree](https://talentsforever.com/mage/60/005205-23550020130133051-005-4)

## How to play

**Then press the first one that is ready**, top to bottom:

1. **Fire Blast**
2. **Scorch** when the target has fewer than 5 stacks of Fire Vulnerability
3. **Pyroblast** when Heating Up has 3 stacks
4. **Fireball**

**Fireball** is your filler: cast it whenever nothing above is ready.

**Advanced: your cooldowns and extras.** Once the list above feels easy, add these:

- **Combustion**: a cooldown, use it at the start of the fight and again whenever it is ready (about 1 time a fight)
- Use your trinkets, your racial and a potion together with your big cooldowns.

*The simulator's full rotation for this build, with every condition: [research rotation page](../research/raid/rotation.md).*
